newsitem.title: JAPAN: JGBs seen weaker on oversupply fears.
newsitem.headline: JGBs seen weaker on oversupply fears.

text.p: JGBs are likely to drift down on Wednesday due to fears of bond oversupply after unsuccessful sales of recently launched JGBs and corporate bonds, traders said.
Tokyo Electric's 100 billion yen 2.625 percent 20-year bond issued at par on Tuesday was traded at a deep discount of 99.40 a few hours after the launch.
Hedge sales against holding NTT's 100 billion 2.5 percent 20-year bond by underwriting brokerages were detected in the JGB futures market on the LIFFE overnight.
